humanRationale: Significant involvement ≠ providing the venue; pivotal role ≠ explicitly causing the event.
materialIssues: “Catskills motel” introduces a specific location drawn only from non-authorized facts.keywords; the authorized overview identifies the parents’ run-down motel but does not place it in the Catskills.

“offers up local grounds” changes the authorized action of calling the festival producers to attract motel business into an unsupported claim that Elliot supplied festival grounds, while the source instead places the gathering on his neighbor’s farm.

“inadvertently sparking the massive gathering of Woodstock” overstates the authorized statement that Elliot and his family played a pivotal role by assigning him a more direct causal role in initiating the gathering.
